insert into album_attribute_value (album_id, attribute_id, value_id) values
(#{item.albumId}, #{item.attributeId}, #{item.valueId})
mapper.select: select aav.*, ba.attribute_name, bv.value_name from album_attribute_value aav join base_attribute ba on aav.attribute_id = ba.id join base_attribute_value bv on aav.value_id = bv.id where aav.album_id = #{albumId} and aav.is_deleted = 0 and ba.is_deleted = 0 and bv.is_deleted = 0 order by aav.attribute_id, aav.value_id
